group_trips.title: Dubai Desert, Skyline and Abu Dhabi Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure group trip through Dubai's skyline, souks and dunes to Abu Dhabi's grand mosque and Louvre, led by a trip captain.
group_trips.overview:
This small-group trip brings together the two UAE cities most travellers want to see. You begin in Dubai with a Marina dhow cruise, a city tour and a visit to the Burj Khalifa observation deck, then head into the dunes for an evening desert safari.

A day in Abu Dhabi follows, with the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the Corniche waterfront. Returning to Dubai, you have a relaxed final day before departure. A trip captain stays with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Marina dhow cruise on the first evening
Dubai city tour with a Burj Khalifa observation deck visit
Desert safari with dune bashing and a camp dinner
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi
Louvre Abu Dhabi and a stroll along the Corniche
Trip captain throughout and Indian meal options on request

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai | Marina Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Dubai airport, where you are met and transferred to your hotel.
Check in and freshen up.
In the evening, enjoy a dhow cruise along Dubai Marina with dinner on board.
Overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour | Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out on a guided city tour with photo stops at Jumeirah Beach and Burj Al Arab.
See the Palm Jumeirah from the viewing points and visit Dubai Creek and the old souks.
In the evening, visit the Burj Khalifa observation deck and spend time at Dubai Mall.
Overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Leisure Morning | Desert Safari
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a relaxed morning at leisure for shopping or rest.
In the afternoon, drive into the desert for dune bashing and sunset views.
Settle into a desert camp for Arabic coffee, traditional entertainment and a BBQ dinner.
Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Dubai to Abu Dhabi | Grand Mosque and Louvre
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to Abu Dhabi.
Visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, one of the world's largest mosques.
In the afternoon, explore the Louvre Abu Dhabi and take a walk along the Corniche.
Overnight stay in Abu Dhabi.

itinerary.title: Yas Island Drive-By | Return to Dubai
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive past Yas Island for photo stops.
Return by road to Dubai and check in to your hotel.
Spend the afternoon and evening at leisure, perhaps at Dubai Mall or the Dubai Fountain.
Overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Departure from Dubai
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel.
Transfer to Dubai airport for your onward flight.
Depart with memories of the Emirates.

group_trips.title: Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure group trip from the Dubai skyline to the mountains of Ras Al Khaimah and the heritage quarter of Sharjah, led by a trip captain.
group_trips.overview:
Most visitors see only Dubai. This group trip adds two more emirates, giving you a fuller picture of the UAE in six days. You see Dubai's landmarks, Dubai Frame and the old souks, then travel north to Ras Al Khaimah for the mountain scenery of Jebel Jais and a night by the coast.

On the way back you stop in Sharjah for its mosque, lagoon and traditional markets before a final day in Dubai with the Burj Khalifa observation deck. A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Dubai city tour with Dubai Frame and the old souks
Scenic drive up Jebel Jais, the UAE's highest mountain, in Ras Al Khaimah
A night on the coast in Ras Al Khaimah
Al Noor Mosque and the Khalid Lagoon waterfront in Sharjah
Traditional souks in Sharjah
Burj Khalifa observation deck and a trip captain throughout
